about.keptInBrowser:
This application fetches EXIF data from your file within your browser,
so the file is kept within your browser and not sent to any servers.
about.usageData:
To improve this application, it collects usage information, such as
the pages that are opened, the file format of the loaded photo and
the errors that occurred, along with your IP address and the approximate
location derived from it. You can turn this off in Settings.
about.reportIssues: If you find any bugs or issues, please submit them in <issuesLink>GitHub Issues</issuesLink>.
about.sourceCode: The source code of this application is hosted on <gitHubLink>GitHub</gitHubLink>.
about.translations: Translations into other languages are welcome: see <guideLink>how to translate this application</guideLink>.
about.developedBy: This application is developed by Tomoyuki Aota.
about.photoLocationMap:
Want to see the map for the locations of many photos all at once?
Photo Location Map is available for such purposes.
